title: include names a missing file
notes: Fixed. `process_include` catches the read failure before parsing and builds the same diagnostic an `import:` of a missing file gets (`import_read_diagnostic`, keyword `include`), so the header says `cannot include`, the rule is about `include:`, and the help names the directory the path is resolved from. The command line's text (`pdl` takes the path ... run `pdl --help`) is gone from this path.
